description: check:guardrails assertion 8 (scripts/grammar-guardrails.mjs): grammar sites that predate the gate. `entries` match by rule, file, construct and, for a lookahead, `resolved` (a fingerprint of what it resolves to, so a widened definition no longer matches); `line` is refreshed by --prune-baselines. `undocumentedRules` lists, by file, the rules with no JSDoc block. This file may only shrink: a new or widened site fails the gate, a removed one must be removed here, and CI fails a pull request that adds an entry.
